title: The Hub That Tells the Truth (IDE v8)
governingContract: docs/IDE-HONESTY-CONTRACT.md (§15 Truth Rules, M55 amendment — landed by G1)
prerequisite: M44 + M53 completion bars met — re-audited by G1 on every run; blocked (never green) when the external fixture or the display tooling is absent

filingEvidence.fixture: $HOME/bb-demo-hub (external declared fixture, owner decision 2026-09-12: used as-is)
filingEvidence.why: the owner's 2026-09-12 report was made against an installed bundle from 2026-09-06 that predated M44.U2/U3/U4/U6; the re-shoot cleared three of four complaints and exposed the six defects this milestone closes

issues.scope: M55 ledger; closure gate (script/m55/verify-governance.ts); §15 Truth Rules in the contract doc, machine-gated; the screenshot protocol pinned; M44 + M53 bars re-audited on every run
acceptanceCriteria: gate exits 0 at a HEAD where the M44 and M53 gates also exit 0; exits non-zero for each planted mutant ledger (missing evidence file, stale commit pin, no acceptance criteria, a closable issue behind a planned prerequisite)
evidence JSON machine-emitted with commit pin + working-tree state; no hand-written status anywhere in the ledger
zero files from the M37/M14/M45/M49/M50 lanes touched by an M55 evidence run (diff-asserted)
closureRequirements: M44 bar gate exit 0 recorded; M53 bar re-audited transitively
verify-chain + CI verify:fast wiring present (machine-read from package.json)

evidence.blockedReason: The bar re-audit runs the M53 R1 ladder (m24->m44 gate chain, including both closures) as subprocesses; under heavy machine load those gates' latency budgets can miss, which this gate reports as a failed bar rather than retrying silently.

issues.scope: ONE identity resolver used by hover, graph, impact, references and call hierarchy; a member target resolves through its owning declaration AND the substitution is labeled; the wire carries the resolution as declared data
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: a fixture pins a member target, an accessor target and an absent target; expectations authored before the change
all five surfaces resolve the member target through the owning declaration and render the substitution label (asserted at the wire and in the rendered document)
no surface silently returns the owner while displaying the member's name (label-removal mutant fails the gate)
panel title, hover identity line and wire response agree (differential assertion across all three)
closureRequirements: the constructor case reproduced by V1's fresh-install frame showing the label

issues.scope: call hierarchy on the same relationship truth as the hub: call-site ranges, no self-references, expand never errors, declared depth/cycle policy
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: a fixture with a mutual pair, a self-recursive method and a 3-deep chain is authored before the change
wire assertions: no self-references in incoming/outgoing; every fromRanges position resolves to the invocation token in the source bytes
every expandable node expands without an error response; the fixture's cycle renders the declared cycle marker
in-editor leg: the native Call hierarchy view opened from a hover shows the expected callers and clicking one lands on the CALL SITE with the correct symbol highlighted (frame + machine assertion)
mutants: reintroduced declaration-ranges, reintroduced self-loop and a swallowed expand error each fail the gate
closureRequirements: V1's fresh-install frame for the call-hierarchy flow
the previous -32603 expand error reproduced as a permanent mutant

evidence.blockedReason: the analyzer stores relationship line_number = 0 for every row today; the call-site positions here are derived from the caller's own source, which is why they are exact. The stored-value path (a future analyzer change) is exercised only as a declared fallback.

issues.scope: ONE relation vocabulary: 'usages' means stored usage sites; hover count, hover list, bb/graph callers/references and textDocument/references agree or each state their declared filter
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: a fixture with a symbol having zero callers, a callee, an owning class and multiple call sites
differential wire assertions across hover count, hover list, bb/graph callers, bb/graph references and textDocument/references under their declared filters
the zero-caller symbol renders '0 usages' and no usages list (declared absence) — never its callees or its class
rendered-copy assertions: usages rows are invocation sites (file:line), checked against the source bytes
mutants: a count derived from callees, a list including the owning declaration, and a count disagreeing with the rendered rows each fail the gate
closureRequirements: the four-way disagreement recorded at filing time is gone at the evidence HEAD (the numbers are re-read from the same surfaces)

evidence.blockedReason: The analyzers of the confirmatory languages DID stop storing line_number = 0 for call rows: measured on a real `bb index` run of this repository's own sources, every TypeScript call row carries a real call-site line (rows for `main`, `twiceOneLine`, `twiceTwoLines` stored lines 4, 10, 13 and 14). The prior limitation text ('verified on the demo index: every TypeScript/Java usage row carries 0') is STALE and is corrected here. Per-language coverage of a real call-site line is M59.A7's claim; on the five real indexes read for this integration, real lines dominate (e.g. 765,602 of 766,227 rows on 818db37d; 99c211a1 is 160,007 of 160,007) but NULL lines exist (625 on 818db37d, 384 on 6f461b7b) and are what the labelled-declaration-substitute branch is for.

issues.scope: ONE signature renderer for hover, hub rows and call-hierarchy detail; no raw JSON in rendered text; unresolved types render a declared unknown
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: no-param, multi-param, optional, rest, generic and one unresolved type
no rendered signature matches the raw-JSON shape /[{[]"?(name|type)"?\s*:/ on any surface (mutation-checked)
unresolved types render the declared unknown marker; the wire's structured parameter data is unchanged and still typed
mutants: reintroduced JSON interpolation, an empty-string parameter and a silently dropped parameter each fail the gate
closureRequirements: V1's frame shows a human signature in the card at the evidence HEAD

evidence.blockedReason: No analyzer on this machine writes a rest/variadic FLAG (isRest/rest/variadic) or isImplicit for anything but a receiver — the fixture declares the flag form AND the stored-name form (`...rest`, `*rest`) and the gate exercises both. The flag is the declared contract for analyzers; the name marker is the fallback the renderer honors today.

issues.scope: ONE evidence-tier classifier for classes, members, fields and externals; hover provenance, hover tier list, hub row chip, legend and stored rows agree
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: one class, one method, one field and one external symbol with authored tier expectations
differential assertions across provenance.evidenceClass, evidenceTiers, the hub row chip, the legend's tier set and the stored rows for all four symbols
a member rule that differs from the class rule, or a symbol claiming two tiers when the rows support one, fails the gate
the render path uses the same tier→badge mapping as renderLegend (single source asserted at source level)
closureRequirements: the greet/greetAll tier divergence recorded at filing time is gone at the evidence HEAD

evidence.blockedReason: The fixture's RED proof is the M2 mutant (the pre-T5 rule reintroduced → the gate fails) plus the issue's own step-zero wire probe; the pre-fix build is not replayed because the owner module is new (authored with the fix), so the RED form is reproduced by planting the old rule rather than by reverting code.

issues.scope: panels open as a preview tab in the current editor group by default (owner decision 2026-09-12); one panel per kind, reused and updated; preserveFocus; bb.panelPlacement setting honored and remembered
acceptanceCriteria: in-editor leg: the editor column count is unchanged after opening hub, impact and graph from three hover actions in one session
the active editor is still the source file after each open (no focus theft)
opening the same panel twice reuses it (one webview, no duplicate column or title)
bb.panelPlacement: beside still opens beside; the default opens in the active group; the choice survives a reload
mutant: a reintroduced hardcoded ViewColumn.Beside fails the gate
closureRequirements: V1's frame shows a single editor column after the filing run's full flow sequence

issues.scope: the filing rig promoted to script/m55: screenshot-protocol.ts (build+install isolated, drive the declared flows, capture frames + manifest), wire-probe (the stdio truth), verify-live-surface.ts (differential + pixel reads-back), wired into the verify chains
acceptanceCriteria: wired into the npm verify chain and the CI verify:fast chain (machine-read from package.json)
fails when the installed bundle hash is not the HEAD build, and when any T1–T5 mutant is planted
a full run records bundle hash, VS Code version, fixture hash, every frame + hash, the probe's raw JSON and the verdict
every claim in the completion report maps to a frame or a probe line (the evidence file lists the mapping)
closureRequirements: the external-fixture blocked path proven (run with the fixture absent → blocked with a reason, never green)
G1's truth-rule 5 enforcement reads this gate's frames

evidence.blockedReason: The frames leg depends on the declared EXTERNAL fixture ($HOME/bb-demo-hub), its owner index in ~/.bb, and the display tooling — by owner decision the fixture is not vendored into the repo, so on a machine without it the leg is BLOCKED-WITH-REASON, never green.

issues.scope: program closure audit M24→M55 at one HEAD; the owner's v8 verdict pack (every claim with its frame); the cross-language false-positive hand-off note to the analyzer lane; the v9 statement
acceptanceCriteria: every M55 issue's evidence exists at the audit HEAD (a stale pin fails G1's ladder)
the audit records, per milestone: gate command, exit code, evidence file, commit pin — machine-emitted
the hand-off note is a linked issue in the analyzer lane carrying the stored cross-language row + probe evidence; this issue links it
the verdict pack lists every claim with its frame path; a claim with no frame is removed rather than softened
closureRequirements: the owner's verdict recorded (§8.5) — the gate never declares the milestone achieved

evidence.blockedReason: X1 is the auditor, so its own evidence pin is self-consistency (written at the audit HEAD by this run) rather than a pre-existing pin: requiring the latter would make the gate un-passable at a fresh HEAD. The eight other issues ARE pin-checked.
